messages:
anya: quick FYI — publish pipeline stopped on regendiff. typegen produced a different enum ordering which bumped the js-sdk version from 0.3.2 -> 0.4.0, but no changelog entry so publish-gate failed. also pulling the new package caused sample-app e2e auth to flake.

devon: saw the failed run in CI: //devex/publish:js-sdk-publish. excerpt from logs:
```
ci-bot: regendiff check: detected semantic changes in generated client. package.json version incremented.
ERROR: missing changelog for bumped versions. publish blocked.
```

marco: any evidence it's a real API change vs generator nondeterminism?

anya: looks nondet — typegen changed enum list order. no server schema change. diff snippet:
```
- "status": { "enum": ["ok","warn","err"] }
+ "status": { "enum": ["warn","ok","err"] }
```
semver-bot flags any enum ordering change as a public surface delta, which caused the bump.

jess: that explains the auth break in sample-app?

linh: yes — regenerated client serializes headers in slightly different order; our retry wrapper relied on a header-shape assumption and ended up reauthing repeatedly in local dev. I pushed a tiny guard to sample-app so 401 triggers at most one immediate reauth attempt. opening PR.

sam: two workstreams: (A) make typegen deterministic (stable sort) and add a regen unit test, (B) harden sample-app auth/retry to tolerate header ordering. owners?

anya: i'll open a small PR to run typegen with --stable-sort and add a golden-regendiff test that asserts sorted enums. will also pin package.json back to 0.3.2 to unblock publish.

devon: for short-term unblock we can allow a one-off semver override in publish job but must document it. sam, can you coordinate that?

sam: yes i'll add a temporary CI exception with a comment referencing the PR. it'll require two approvals and auto-expire in 48h.

marco: long-term we should change semver-bot rules to ignore pure-ordering diffs or normalize enums before semantic analysis. filing issue #DX-regen-14.

anya: added changelog entry explaining this was a regen-only normalization in the PR. PR link: (internal) — awaiting reviews.

ci-bot: action: rerun //devex/publish:js-sdk-publish after PR merge. use `runtool retry 3519881234`.

linh: sample-app PR opened: guard retry + case-insensitive header parsing. tests added. cc @sam for review.

jess: nice catch. can we add a lint that fails on generators that don't pass --stable-sort? helps catch before CI.

anya: added a pregen check in the PR to assert the typegen binary supports --stable-sort; falls back to failing with clear message.

sam: plan: merge both PRs, rerun CI, then revert temporary semver override. keep issue DX-regen-14 for semver-bot follow-up.

devon: thanks. small note — keep an eye on other SDKs (python/go) in case their generators exhibit similar nondet behavior. might be platform-specific (mac vs linux sort).

anya: ack, will run cross-platform regen locally as part of the golden test matrix.

linh: once CI is green, i'll post the e2e run.

sam: thanks everyone — good example of DX, tooling, and release flow intersecting. :coffee:
